items.title: Ref Watch: Arsenal's red card appeal will fail - Dowman was aggressive
items.excerpt: Former Premier League referee Dermot Gallagher believes Arsenal's appeal against Max Dowman's red card in their shock Carabao Cup defeat to Fleetwood Town will fail.
body: Former Premier League referee Dermot Gallagher believes Arsenal's appeal against Max Dowman's red card in their shock Carabao Cup defeat to Fleetwood Town will fail.
Dowman was sent off for violent conduct after kicking out at Harrison Neal following the defender's strong challenge on the teenager late in the fourth-round tie, which Arsenal lost on penalties.
Arsenal must submit appeal documents by 1pm on Thursday and are hopeful a decision will be made before their match at Liverpool, live on Sky Sports on Sunday.

However, when asked if he thought Arsenal's appeal would be successful, Gallagher told Sky Sports News : "I don't, because of the aggressiveness of Dowman, and you can see the intent. I think it will fail." Fernandes was an unused substitute after being dropped for the 3-0 defeat against Bournemouth on Sunday after he criticised Carrick's tactics following the 4-1 thrashing at Como in the Champions League.
Carrick had described his reasons for dropping his captain as "pure football".

items.title: Carrick to remain in charge of Man Utd for Chelsea trip
items.excerpt: Michael Carrick will remain in charge of Manchester United for their game against Chelsea on Saturday.
body: Michael Carrick will remain in charge of Manchester United for their game against Chelsea on Saturday.

The under-pressure United head coach was thought to be on the brink after Sunday's crushing 3-0 defeat at home to Bournemouth, but he and the players are being given the chance to turn the current situation around.

United's director of football, Jason Wilcox, and chief executive, Omar Berrada, were at Carrington discussing Carrick's future on Monday. It is understood they had already been considering alternatives for the head coach role.

However, Carrick took training on Tuesday and the decision has been taken to give him at least one more match. Eddie Howe and Julian Nagelsmann are among the contenders to replace him if he is sacked. items.title: Fleetwood Town vs Arsenal: The Cod Army Dare to Dream of a Carabao Cup
items.excerpt: A David vs Goliath clash is underway as Fleetwood Town, the minnows, prepare to challenge one of English football's biggest clubs, Arsenal, in the third round of the EFL
body: Fleetwood Town have not been at their best in the 2026-27 League Two campaign with just three wins from 13 games. The Lancashire-based outfit have no choice but to turn their attention to the EFL Cup to restore their confidence.

The Cod Army are competing in the third round of this competition for the first time in club history. It has been a terrific run, with the team securing wins over fellow League Two opponents Chesterfield and Shrewsbury Town before upsetting Championship side Sheffield United in the second round with a 1-0 home victory.

Fleetwood Town's success in the EFL Cup has been built on their organised defense that has kept three clean sheets. Keeping another clean sheet would allow them to match Tranmere Rovers' achievement from the 1988-89 campaign, a record that has stood among fourth-tier teams ever since.

Head coach Matt Lawlor and company now have their eyes on a bigger prize: slaying the giant. Arsenal present a tough challenge but the minnows will be determined to rewrite the script and make this a night to remember.

items.title: “A Dream Come True” - England Captain Harry Kane Wins 2026 Ballon d’Or
items.excerpt: England’s captain Harry Kane was announced as the 2026 Ballon d’Or winner last night in London. The Bayern Munich striker edged Real Madrid’s Kylian Mbappe and Barcelona’
body: Harry Kane has won the 2026 Ballon d’Or, becoming the first Englishman to receive football’s most prestigious individual honour since Michael Owen in 2001.

The 33-year-old Bayern Munich and England captain was presented with the coveted golden ball in London last night, bringing an end to a 25-year wait for an English winner and further strengthening his legacy in the game.

Kane confirmed our football prediction by finishing ahead of Real Madrid’s Kylian Mbappe in second and Lamine Yamal of Barcelona in third. He also clinched the Gerd Muller Trophy as the season’s outstanding striker following a stunning campaign for both club and country.

Bayern’s talisman scored 73 goals and provided eight assists in 65 appearances for his club and the Three Lions. His 61 goals in 51 matches for the Bavarians is the highest single-season total by a player in the club’s history and the most for a club in one of Europe’s top five leagues since Cristiano Ronaldo for Real Madrid.
